---

**Before you post, please check:**

- You have redacted every personal identifier — instance URLs, emails, chat ids, document ids and
  anything that looks like a key. This is a public issue.
- If the problem is a `SET_ME_` placeholder failing, that is deliberate. Each one fails loudly at
  its own node rather than half-working. Replace it with your own value.
- If you have found a secret exposed anywhere in this repo, do **not** open an issue. Open a
  [security advisory](../../security/advisories/new) instead.
